text.aria-label: Title text 'D10 (signed MW metering), logged event of 54 days. Grey and dashed lines: the event's start and end. Lines: observed power, and the median of the forecast issued at 12:00 UTC for the next 24 hours (seed mean), from 14 days before the start to 7 days after the end. Forecasts exist only in the scored origin months, so lines break between them. NGED's logs may miss events.'
text.tspan: D10 (signed MW metering), logged event of 54 days. Grey and dashed lines: the event's start and end.
Lines: observed power, and the median of the forecast issued at 12:00 UTC for the next 24 hours
(seed mean), from 14 days before the start to 7 days after the end. Forecasts exist only in the
scored origin months, so lines break between them. NGED's logs may miss events.
